==Summary==
: {{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}

[[Lan]] asks [[Perrin]] how he knew the [[Gray Man|Gray Men]] were there and he says he could smell them. Lan takes Perrin outside and [[Faile]] and [[Loial]] go with them. Lan says they are going to look for something, but doesn’t know what. Perrin follows Lan to a hound print in the stone with a trail leading to and from the inn. They are prints from a [[Darkhound]] which only leaves prints in stone but not dirt. Lan again offers Faile the chance to leave as she has not learned too much yet, but she still declines. Lan tells them to go get some sleep as he is going after [[Moiraine]] to tell her of the Darkhound.

Perrin goes to sleep, hoping to enter the [[Tel'aran'rhiod|wolf dream]] and talk with [[Hopper]] and find out why Gray Men and Darkhounds are after him. 

First he finds himself in what he thinks are someone else's dreams. They feature a tall man, sometimes holding [[Callandor|a blazing sword]], sometimes sitting in a throne with kings and queens groveling before him.{{ref|This is most likely [[Sammael]] since he's nearby and he always wished he were tall.}}

Then he experiences a series of images while standing atop a mountain in a rugged landscape.

*[[Mat]] is dicing with [[Ba'alzamon]] without realizing it.
*[[Egwene]], [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]] stand looking at a huge metal cage with a raised door held on a heavy spring. They release the door, trapping themselves. [[Liandrin Guirale|A woman with her hair in braids]] laughs at them and [[Lanfear|a woman in white]] laughs at the woman in braids.

Hopper arrives and Perrin asks the wolf about the Gray Men and Darkhounds. Hopper only says that the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Hunt]] comes and that he should flee the Shadowbrothers. Hopper knocks him off the mountain cliff to force him to waken when he hits the ground. When Perrin wakes up, Zarine is there and she wonders if he is the [[Dragon Reborn]], considering his company and those chasing him. Moiraine storms into the room, saying that Perrin's wolf dreams are indeed as true as a [[Dreaming|Dreamer]]'s. She has confirmed that the [[Forsaken]] are loose and [[Sammael|one of them]] rules in Illian.
